title: heterotheca oregona var. compacta
intro: Heterotheca oregona var. compacta, commonly known as Oregon compact goldenweed, is a flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oregon compact goldenweed include its ability to soothe irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
